# GPT Image 2: 80+ structured image prompt templates

Curated by Skill Harbor — @conardli's focused skill for GPT Image 2, with 80+ structured prompt templates across 18 categories: UI mockups, product visuals, maps, slides and visual docs, posters and campaigns, portraits and characters, scenes and illustrations, editing workflows (background/object replacement, retouching), avatars, storyboards and manga sequences, grids and collages, branding and packaging, typography, game assets, academic figures (strict no-fabricated-data rules for quantitative charts), infographics, and technical diagrams. It runs in three modes — A (Garden local generation via OpenAI-compatible API with an API key), B (host-native: render the prompt and hand it to the agent's own image tool), or C (advisor: produce the high-quality prompt only, no generation), decided by a first-run mode-detection script. Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Chinese**; Mode A requires an OpenAI-compatible API key (paid usage) — Modes B and C work without one; rendered prompts default to a `garden-gpt-image-2/prompt/` folder and Mode A images to `garden-gpt-image-2/image/`; technical diagrams are bitmap PNGs, not editable SVG; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
